  │  Setup Wizard                               │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Re-run the initial setup wizard.

  Usage:
    /setup
    /onboarding

  Details:
    Runs the full onboarding flow again: provider selection, API key
    entry, and model selection.

  Examples:
    $ /setup

  Related: /config  /switch
